proposal.observation: Round 2 increased midpoint evidence from 0.2 to 0.3 and reduced phase incoherence from 29.2 to 26.4 degrees, but proxy, fill, real-detection ratio, and fallback ratio were unchanged. The prompt set remains an incoherent 50/50 mixture: five regular assumed points coexist with five detections spread across widely separated circumferential rows, while ring count and x spacing are already exact.
proposal.failure_mode: f_spurious_lines: weak real oblique and horizontal candidates are being mixed with an otherwise coherent geometric fallback grid, producing unstable prompt y positions and high segment-size variation.
proposal.rationale: The permissive round-2 detector found extra line fragments but did not improve the proxy or reduce fallback dependence. For this final orthogonal test, suppress marginal line candidates and force synthetic vertical-ring handling so prompt generation uses a more coherent geometric regime. Raising both Hough thresholds and the binary threshold rejects weak fragments, while the maximum vertical threshold preserves the already-correct ten-ring grid through fallback. SAM, denoising, and unfolding remain untouched.
